meta.title: Monitoring for Web, Social Media & Data | dynamiq.
meta.description: dynamiq. builds monitoring systems for the web, social media, communities and data. Detect changes, emerging narratives and relevant signals.

heading: Don't watch
everything.
hero.lead: Markets change. Competitors reposition themselves. Discussions emerge on new platforms. Narratives gain reach.
hero.text: dynamiq. monitors the sources relevant to your question and makes change systematically measurable.

feed.footer: Source collected. Change detected. Signal delivered.

signals.heading: Don't watch everything.
signals.introOne: Monitoring at dynamiq. starts with a question, not a keyword list.
signals.introTwo: First, we define which changes matter to your decision. Then we collect the right sources regularly and check them for those specific signals.

process.heading: From a question
process.aria: The monitoring process in five steps
process.note: Your question determines the sources, collection frequency and detection criteria. The output fits your workflow.

sources.heading: Monitoring across
sources.intro: A relevant signal rarely emerges in just one place.
sources.aria: Sources for a custom monitoring system
sources.ownedExamples: APIs · databases · existing datasets · internal data sources
sources.ownedText: Data monitoring can also build on data you already collect or provide for analysis.
sources.connectionText: A signal on TikTok can be analysed alongside changes on a website, discussions on Reddit or existing company data.

outputs.heading: Monitoring doesn't have to mean
outputs.intro: A signal is useful when it reaches the right team. We deliver results in the format you need for your work.

context.heading: Go beyond
context.baselinePrompt: Traditional monitoring often answers questions such as:
context.baselineQuestion: How often was our brand mentioned?

custom.heading: When standard software
paragraphs: Not every monitoring question can be answered with an existing SaaS tool.
Sometimes specific sources need to be collected, unusual signals defined or different datasets connected.
In those cases, we build the collection, analysis and monitoring pipeline ourselves. A custom monitoring system designed around your question.

contact.label: Discuss monitoring
contact.heading: What would you like
contact.introOne: Tell us the question, source or signal that matters to you.
contact.introTwo: Together, we work out which data is needed and what a useful monitoring setup could look like.
contact.help: Describe the question, source or signal you want to monitor. Existing data and your desired outcome help us understand the scope.

signals.label: Recurring narrative detected
signals.detail: An argument appears in new videos

signals.label: New product page detected
signals.detail: A new offering appears on the website

categories.label: Competitors
categories.text: Detect new products, price changes, positioning, campaigns and strategic shifts.

categories.label: Brands & communications
categories.text: Track where brands, products and topics appear, and in which contexts.
categories.example: A brand appears in a new context.

categories.label: Narratives & topics
categories.text: Identify emerging discussions, recurring arguments and the actors spreading them.
categories.example: A narrative gains reach across multiple sources.

categories.label: Platforms & communities
categories.text: Identify new accounts, videos, posts, comments and communities, and track how they develop over time.
categories.example: A new TikTok account becomes relevant to a topic.

categories.label: Websites
categories.text: Check content, offers, documents and defined website sections for changes.
categories.example: A product page or document changes.

categories.label: Markets & trends
categories.text: Observe which products, categories, actors and topics gain or lose attention.
categories.example: A product gains attention in several communities.

pipeline.label: Define
pipeline.question: What do we want to detect?
pipeline.text: Define the question, relevant sources and specific signals.

pipeline.label: Collect
pipeline.question: Which data do we need?
pipeline.text: Collect publicly accessible or provided data regularly and store it in a structured format.

pipeline.label: Analyze
pipeline.question: What is happening in the data?
pipeline.text: Analyse text, video, metadata, entities, networks and developments over time.

pipeline.label: Detect
pipeline.question: What has changed?
pipeline.text: Identify new actors, unusual developments, recurring narratives and other defined events.

pipeline.label: Deliver
pipeline.question: What does the team need to know?
pipeline.text: Deliver results as alerts, dashboards, reports, search systems, datasets or APIs.

outputs.label: Alerts
outputs.text: Notifications when defined events or changes occur. Exactly when a signal becomes relevant.

outputs.label: Dashboards
outputs.text: An ongoing view of relevant developments, with timelines and the context of the underlying sources.

outputs.label: Reports
outputs.text: Regular summaries with interpretation: what has changed, and what does it mean for your question?

outputs.label: Search
outputs.text: Searchable archives and intelligence databases for tracing content, actors and developments.

outputs.label: API
outputs.text: Structured data and detected events for existing systems, internal tools and your own workflows.

outputs.label: Raw Data
outputs.text: Datasets as CSV, JSON, databases or other machine-readable formats for your own analysis.

teams.label: Strategy & Competitive Intelligence
teams.text: Monitor competitors, markets, products and positioning. Identify changes that matter to strategic decisions.

teams.label: Brand & Communications
teams.text: Track brand perception, discussions, narratives and relevant actors. Understand visibility in context.

teams.label: Market & Consumer Intelligence
teams.text: Identify products, trends, needs and changes. Interpret developments across platforms and time periods.

teams.label: Research & Investigations
teams.text: Document and investigate actors, networks, content and sources over extended periods. Connect observations in a traceable way.
